detailZones.title: CT bay
detailZones.description: Inspect the CT gantry, aperture, couch, control details and the adjacent wash area.

detailZones.title: MRI bay
detailZones.description: Follow the MRI magnet, tunnel, patient couch, head cradle, trolley and console desk.

detailZones.title: X-ray and mammography
detailZones.description: Inspect the radiography room, mammography assembly, X-ray tube and detector hardware.

detailZones.title: Control room
detailZones.description: Study the workstation, desk, monitor, chair, console keypad and glass control partition.

detailZones.title: Ultrasound bay
detailZones.description: Follow the portable ultrasound machine, probe, gel bottle, cart and examination couch.

detailZones.title: Preparation and supplies
detailZones.description: Inspect contrast preparation, protective garments, storage, handwashing and room hardware.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source and resized radiology-suite photographs were inspected at native and final pixels. This batch retains 87 independently pointable imaging-room fixtures and equipment parts across CT, MRI, X-ray, mammography, control, ultrasound and preparation areas. Patient procedures, diagnoses, radiation dose, staff roles, brands, unreadable screen content and hidden machine functions were excluded.
